build_resnet_model: build a ResNet model with configurable blocks, channels, and optional additional cosmological features for galaxy classification
run_resnet_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ResNet model with input images and optional additional features
build_linearbnrelu_module: build a LinearBNReLU module that combines a linear layer with batch normalization and ReLU activation
run_linearbnrelu_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the LinearBNReLU module with input tensor and training flag
review_resnet_additional_features: review the ResNet class to understand how additional features are injected in per_block or mlp mode
